table_title: In what year did each current EU member state join the European Union?
db_analog: SELECT country, accession_year FROM eu_member_states WHERE membership_status = 'current' ORDER BY accession_year, country
temporal_note: Sourced from the Wikipedia article 'Member state of the European Union' (main member-states table, 'Acceded' column), accessed 2026-06-01. Universe is the 27 current EU member states; the United Kingdom is excluded as a former member (withdrew 31 January 2020). 'Year of EU Accession' is the year of the accession date the table lists for each state: the six founding members are dated to the Treaty of Rome (25 March 1957, shown as 'Founder') and later entrants to their enlargement's effective date (e.g., 1 January 1973, 1 January 1981, 1 May 2004, 1 July 2013). Values are stable historical facts and change only with future accessions or withdrawals.
_extraction_notes: Repair cycle 2 (addresses Codex audit cycle 1). Originally staged via datasets/build_benchmark/sparql_to_csv.py from the Wikidata SPARQL endpoint (statement-node form p:P463/ps:P463 = Q458 with pq:P580 start-time, excluding pq:P582 end-time to drop Brexit UK). The raw Wikidata P580 values dated five founders to 1957 (Treaty of Rome signed, 25 March 1957) but Germany to 1958 (Treaty in force, 1 January 1958), producing an internally inconsistent founder cohort that the audit flagged as BLOCKING. Re-grounded the instance to the Wikipedia 'Member state of the European Union' table, which dates ALL six founders to 25 March 1957 ('Founder', Treaty of Rome). Germany's value was normalized 1958 -> 1957 to match the cited table (now source-grounded, not parametric). Accordingly gt_construction was changed sparql_wikidata -> manual_wikipedia and source_urls re-pointed to the Wikipedia table; the .sparql file at datasets/build_benchmark/sparql_queries/eu_member_states_accession_years.sparql remains in the repo as build history but is no longer the authoritative source (its raw P580 would re-introduce the DE=1958 inconsistency). Result: 27 rows x 2 columns, all six founders at 1957, 0 duplicate primary keys; every row matches the cited Wikipedia member-state table.
